svg.title: Agent trace data minimization
svg.desc: <g font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace"> <rect x="64" y="130" width="1152" height="424" fill="#17222d"/> <text x="100" y="186" fill="#6c7478" font-size="18">TRACE EVENT / BEFORE STORAGE</text> <text x="100" y="246" fill="#f3f1eb" font-size="22">user_id</text><rect x="314" y="220" width="280" height="38" fill="#277187"/><text x="628" y="246" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">pseudonymized</text> <text x="100" y="312" fill="#f3f1eb" font-size="22">prompt</text><rect x="314" y="286" width="640" height="38" fill="#d9572b"/><text x="988" y="312" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">dropped</text> <text x="100" y="378" fill="#f3f1eb" font-size="22">tool_args</text><rect x="314" y="352" width="520" height="38" fill="#d9572b"/><text x="868" y="378" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">redacted</text> <text x="100" y="444" fill="#f3f1eb" font-size="22">latency_ms</text><rect x="314" y="418" width="180" height="38" fill="#dbe7e5"/><text x="528" y="444" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">kept</text> <text x="100" y="510" fill="#f3f1eb" font-size="22">status</text><rect x="314" y="484" width="180" height="38" fill="#dbe7e5"/><text x="528" y="510" fill="#dbe7e5" font-size="18">kept</text> </g>
